title: 학생군사교육실시령 시행규칙 / queue:ADDENDUM:00403:19890727:00006:part:1/1
full_text:
Article 403, July 27, 1989

① (Effective Date) This regulation shall take effect from the date of its promulgation.

② (Procedure for shortening the service period of personnel who have completed the general military education) Regarding the procedure for shortening the service period for personnel who have completed the general military education course at the time this regulation takes effect, the provisions of the previous regulations shall apply.

③ (Procedure for continuing the use of existing forms) The existing forms in Appendix No. 2 to Appendix No. 4, which are to be deleted by the implementation of this regulation, shall continue to be used in accordance with Article 2 of this regulation.
